quotes.text: Show me the IRR, not the clubhouse.
quotes.author: — Nikhil

quotes.text: This money must not become a second job.
quotes.author: — Deepa

quotes.text: Proposed infra is a story; tendered with a contractor name is a catalyst.
quotes.author: — Riya

quotes.text: You've said your four conditions eleven times. The twelfth time, we write them down and you sign.
quotes.author: — Riya

chatMessages.text: Riya, I added a column yesterday. Cost of my own analysis: ₹35 lakhs. Eleven months of being 'two weeks from deciding.'
You computed it yourself — that's rarer than you think. What would make you act? A mandate against yourself. Kitchens are where mandates survive.

tabs.name: Learnings
tabs.label: Learnings
tabs.title: What this journey teaches us.
tabs.description: Key takeaways for data-driven investors balancing pre-launch upside against delivery risk and analysis costs.

lessons.title: 'Tendered with contractor name' is the only real catalyst.
lessons.description: Proposed infrastructure is just marketing story. Filtering for tendered projects with named contractors instantly eliminated half the speculative list.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: A vector graphic showing a government infrastructure tender document stamped with a contractor name, rendered in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette (#1E1E1E to #FFFFFF) with a Warm Coral #FF8A65 focal accent, Scandinavian minimalism, Apple-inspired product aesthetics, soft ambient lighting, clean white background, editorial quality.

lessons.title: Early-bird pricing compensates for delivery risk.
lessons.description: 8–12% pre-launch discounts are not free money; they are compensation for 2029 completion timelines. Price the risk before signing.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: A vector illustration showing a price sheet discount calculation beside a construction delivery timeline, rendered in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette (#1E1E1E to #FFFFFF) with a Warm Coral #FF8A65 focal accent, Scandinavian minimalism, Apple-inspired product aesthetics, soft ambient lighting, clean white background, editorial quality.

lessons.title: Corridors arrive late. Always.
lessons.description: Back-testing 2021 predictions showed being right on direction but wrong on timing by 2+ years. Build buffer for delays.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: A vector chart comparing predicted vs actual infrastructure completion timelines, rendered in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette (#1E1E1E to #FFFFFF) with a Warm Coral #FF8A65 focal accent, Scandinavian minimalism, Apple-inspired product aesthetics, soft ambient lighting, clean white background, editorial quality.

lessons.title: Decide on written mandate rules to beat analysis cost.
lessons.description: Every month of over-analyzing cost ₹1.4L in foregone appreciation. Write down decision conditions and obey them.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: A vector illustration of a framed 4-rule mandate card on a kitchen table, rendered in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette (#1E1E1E to #FFFFFF) with a Warm Coral #FF8A65 focal accent, Scandinavian minimalism, Apple-inspired product aesthetics, soft ambient lighting, clean white background, editorial quality.

lessons.title: Deepa's rule is an investment filter.
lessons.description: Any real estate asset requiring weekly operational management fails the family's core mandate.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: A vector graphic of a peaceful home office with a closed laptop and a balance sheet, rendered in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette (#1E1E1E to #FFFFFF) with a Warm Coral #FF8A65 focal accent, Scandinavian minimalism, Apple-inspired product aesthetics, soft ambient lighting, clean white background, editorial quality.

differentlyCards.description: Exercising EOI refund when allotment fails guarantees unit quality.

valueProps.title: Written Decision Mandate
valueProps.description: Establish 4 hard rules before starting your search to prevent analysis paralysis.

valueProps.title: Tendered Infrastructure Filter
valueProps.description: Focus only on infrastructure projects with active tenders and named contractors.

valueProps.title: RERA Track Record Diligence
valueProps.description: Verify developer past delivery records and exit liquidity history.

checklistItems: You have capital ready and a spreadsheet that has been "two weeks from final" for most of a year.
You compare every property to an index-fund benchmark, out loud, at site visits.
Launch-window pricing excites you more than ready inventory — you want the developer's early-bird margin, not the resale market's.
You track infrastructure tenders the way others track cricket scores.
You know your analysis is partly fear, and you'd rather not discuss it.
Your spouse has one rule for this money, and you're quietly testing its edges.
